questions.q: Dice A beats Dice B more often than not, and Dice B beats Dice C more often than not. Does Dice A necessarily beat Dice C more often than not?

Only if the dice are loaded unfairly
No — non-transitive dice sets exist where A beats B, B beats C, and yet C beats A
